rubricScores.criterion: Recognized FS0039 errors occur only on net472
Identified undefined symbols as .NET-only hot-reload/loading APIs

scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose the root cause of the compiler errors
scenarios.reasoning: Methodical, evidence-driven binlog analysis: error code distribution, per-task attribution, project file inspection. Output is concise, correct, distinguishes dominant vs secondary causes, cascade vs real errors, and gives actionable fixes. Minor wasted steps on a lost temp file and an odd 'under($task ...)' count, but no impact on correctness.
